item.name: POST /subscriptions/payment-intent - Créer un paiement de test Stripe

exec: pm.test('Statut HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('success vaut true', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Le paiement est de 5 EUR', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.amount).to.eql(500); pm.expect(j.data.currency).to.eql('eur'); });
pm.test('Le client secret est retourné', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.client_secret).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Statut HTTP 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('success vaut false', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('Structure JSON : success, message, errors', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys('success', 'message', 'errors'); });
const secret = pm.environment.get('stripe_webhook_secret');
if (!secret) { throw new Error('Renseignez stripe_webhook_secret dans votre environnement Postman.'); }
const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
const payload = pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.body.raw);
const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', encoder.encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const signatureBytes = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, encoder.encode(timestamp + '.' + payload));
const signature = Array.from(new Uint8Array(signatureBytes), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Stripe-Signature', value: 't=' + timestamp + ',v1=' + signature });
pm.test('Statut HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Le webhook est accepté', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.received).to.eql(true); });
